cases.name: Latrena May
cases.about: Latrena had been a teacher at Pride Academy Charter School in East Orange for six years before her death. Colleagues described her as dedicated, caring and hardworking.
cases.narrative: Latrena fled from Higgs and flagged down a police vehicle for help. As East Orange Detective Kemon Lee exited his vehicle and approached, Higgs fired multiple shots at May. Detective Lee returned fire, striking Higgs in the legs. After the shooting, Higgs barricaded himself inside the residence, where the couple’s then four-year-old daughter was sleeping.
